title: Receipt payload
description: The payload of an engine-signed receipt, basalt-receipt.1.<payload>.<sig>: payload is base64url of these exact JSON bytes, sig is ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 (64 bytes r||s, base64url) over the UTF-8 bytes of "basalt-receipt.1\n" followed by the same JSON bytes. Verify the signature first, then that engineId is the signing key's id, then parse. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Receipts.

status.description: APPROVED for an approval; APPLIED or APPLYING for a revert.

headline.description: What was approved or reverted, built from Postgres's record of the item, never from what the page sent.

agent.description: The agent whose item it is.

changeId.description: The change the signature produced, when there is one when the receipt is made.
